summary.text: Robert Garcia, also known as Rob, is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 71, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned an associate degree in business from Fairmont State University and has worked as a lineman with Mon Power.
Ballotpedia lists him as losing the general election for a House of Delegates seat in 2018, 2020 and 2022, including to incumbent Laura Kimble in District 71 in 2022.
